I, John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Lands herebydeclare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land AcquisitionAct, that the lands described below are needed for a public purposeand will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Two allotments of land called Galpadigawa Waththa in total Extentof about 0.0123 Hectare depicted in Advance Tracing No. Maha/HRS/2015/248 dated 16.07.2015, prepared by the Surveyor Generalsituated in the Village of Medawela in the Minor Division of MedesiyaPattuwa in Divisional Secretary's Division of Harispattuwa in KandyDistrict in Central Province and bound as follows:

01. Lot ‘A ’– Galpadigawa Waththa – Extent: 0.0056 HectareNorth: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Galpadigawa Waththa claimedby D.R.G. Somawathi; East and South:Galpadigawa Waththa claimedby D.R.G. Somawathi; West: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha).

02. Lot ‘B’ – Galpadigawa Waththa – Extent: 0.0067 HectareNorth: Galpadigawa Waththa claimed by D.R.G. Somawathi; East:Galpadigawa Waththa claimed by D.R.G. Somawathi and GalpadigawaWaththa claimed by the State; South:Galpadigawa Waththa claimedby the State; West: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and GalpadigawaWaththa claimed by P. G. S. Tilakasena.
John A. E. Amarathunga,Minister of Lands.
Ref. No.: 4-3/9/2015/WS/52.Ministry of Lands,‘Mihikatha Medura’,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.18th April, 2016.
